name: Ortur Laser Master H10 10W
tagline: 10W Ortur's enclosed-style H-series — faster frame, tighter integration than LM3
tldr: Ortur Laser Master H10 10W is the 10W SKU on the Ortur ortur laser master h10 line. The H10 is Ortur's step up from the open-frame LM3 line: a more integrated chassis with up to 20W diode power and higher advertised traverse speeds. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

priceRange.note: 10W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 10W Ortur's enclosed-style H-series — faster frame, tighter integration than LM3
Open-frame layout — laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 400 × 400 mm on this chassis
10W on Ortur Laser Master H10: engraving-first — photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~28–43 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~14–24 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 5 mm basswood class) — not thick production plywood
Higher modules in this line (20W or 40W) add cut speed and depth
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 5 mm+ stock all day
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W module on Ortur Laser Master H10. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
